rct.title: Root Canal Treatment
rct.desc: Treatment of infected tooth pulp to save your natural tooth using modern, painless techniques.

crown.title: Crown & Bridge
crown.desc: Restore damaged teeth with precision-crafted natural-looking crowns and bridges.

extraction.title: Painless Extraction
extraction.desc: Safe, gentle removal of damaged, decayed, or wisdom teeth with minimal discomfort.

braces.title: Orthodontics & Braces
braces.desc: Correction of crooked, misaligned teeth and jaw problems for a confident smile.

filling.title: Cosmetic Filling
filling.desc: Aesthetic cavity filling with tooth-colored composite — invisible and durable.

implant.title: Dental Implant
implant.desc: Permanent titanium implants that look, feel, and function exactly like natural teeth.

scaling.title: Scaling & Polishing
scaling.desc: Professional cleaning to remove plaque, tartar, and stains for fresh, healthy gums.

denture.title: Dentures
denture.desc: Full and partial dentures for complete or partial tooth loss restoration.

surgery.title: Oral Surgery
surgery.desc: Surgical treatment for gum disease, oral cysts, and complex dental conditions.

trauma.title: Trauma & Fracture
trauma.desc: Emergency care for broken, chipped, or injured teeth — fast and effective.

specialized.title: Specialized Care
specialized.desc: Gentle dentistry for children, pregnant mothers, diabetic & heart patients.

xray.title: Dental X-Ray
xray.desc: Fast, accurate in-house X-ray with our own modern machine — no referral needed.
